industry.description: Productivity, inputs and factor shares by market-sector division, FY2005-06 to FY2024-25 (5260.0.55.002 Tables 1, 6-11, 14 and 19). Value-added based indexes; '_qa' on the quality-adjusted hours basis, '_hours' on the hours-worked basis. Income shares (Table 14) are the labour and capital shares of value added used for value-added MFP; cost shares (Table 19) are shares of gross output, unsmoothed, used for gross-output MFP (may end a year earlier). null = not available.

columns.value: see 'kind': index, per cent (log growth x 100) or proportion (0-1)

market_sector.description: Market-sector (16 industries, divisions A-N, R and S) productivity measures, last 20 years (5260.0.55.002 Table 2): value-added indexes ('kind' index), growth accounting contributions to output growth ('kind' growth, percentage points, natural log growth x 100) and two-period average income shares ('kind' share). Units by kind: index: index (2023-24 = 100); growth: per cent (natural log growth x 100); share: proportion (0-1).

productive_capital_stock.description: Productive capital stock by market-sector division, FY2005-06 to FY2024-25 (5260.0.55.002 Table 12, incorporated plus unincorporated), summed here over asset types: all assets (including land and inventories) and fixed assets (excluding land and inventories). The sum of chain volume components is an approximation, and components the ABS does not publish ('np') are left out of the sum: check components_not_published before using a row.
